findings.title: Internal Control Deficiencies Could Allow Improper Payments
findings.description: One finance office supervisory employee was provided system capabilities in excess of job duties, allowing them to independently record and process critical accounting transactions without independent review.
findings.recommendation: Implement effective internal control over accounts payable and procurement system. Restrict employees' capabilities to only those needed for job duties and eliminate incompatible functions. Ensure verification of disbursement transactions by an employee not having the capability to process related transactions.

findings.title: TCPS Did Not Always Ensure That Procurements Were Competitively Procured as Required or Justified as Sole Source Procurements
findings.description: Test of 55 disbursements totaling $1.96 million disclosed 11 disbursements where only a single quote was received without explanation, and one vendor payments totaled $72,000 were not competitively bid.

dollar_amounts.context: total amount paid to vendors for which competitive quotes were not obtained
total paid to one vendor that was not competitively bid as required

findings.recommendation: Ensure all procurements are performed in accordance with TCPS policies. Adhere to competitive procurement policies and procedures. Adequately document justification for sole source procurements.

findings.title: Certain Users Had Unneeded System Capabilities and Personnel and Payroll Changes Were Not Adequately Reviewed for Propriety
findings.description: Five employees had system capabilities allowing incompatible functions. TCPS lacked independent review to ensure critical personnel data and payroll payments were proper.
findings.recommendation: Ensure adequate internal controls over human resources and payroll system. Restrict employees' capabilities to only those needed for job duties. Periodically generate a report of changes and perform independent supervisory review.

findings.title: TCPS' Policies and Physical Inventory Procedures Need Improvement to Safeguard Equipment
findings.description: Procedures were not adequate for equipment accountability. No complete physical inventory performed in over five years except laptops. Items removed from records without supervisory approval.

dollar_amounts.context: cost of equipment items removed from records without supervisory approval
total cost of non-computer equipment in inventory records

findings.recommendation: Develop and implement policies to ensure accountability over all equipment. Update policies for segregation of duties and physical inventories. Ensure disposals are approved by supervisory personnel.

findings.title: Administrative Access to the TCPS Network Was Excessive and Database Monitoring and Password and Account Controls Over Critical Systems Were Not Sufficient
findings.description: Seven accounts were improperly classified as domain administrators. Student information system database was not configured to log sensitive activity. Password controls did not meet best practices.
findings.recommendation: Limit domain administrator group to employees requiring capabilities. Implement proper database logging and monitoring. Implement appropriate password controls and ensure account lockout is enforced.

findings.title: TCPS Did Not Have an Information Technology Disaster Recovery Plan and Anti-Virus Protection Was Frequently Not Installed or Up-to-Date
findings.description: TCPS did not have a disaster recovery plan. Tests of nine computers disclosed six had no anti-virus software installed.
findings.recommendation: Develop and implement a comprehensive disaster recovery plan. Install effective anti-virus program on every computer with automated updates.

findings.title: TCPS' Network Was Not Properly Secured
findings.description: Firewall rules allowed insecure connections. Publicly accessible servers were on internal network. Internal network not adequately secured from improper access.
findings.recommendation: Configure firewalls to achieve least privilege security strategy. Segregate publicly accessible servers in separate protected network zone. Implement controls to limit network level student access.

findings.title: TCPS' Routing Procedures Were Not Comprehensive and Its Routing Software Capabilities Were Not Fully Utilized
findings.description: Bus routing process did not consider all relevant factors. Automated routing software capabilities were not fully used to develop efficient routes.

dollar_amounts.context: average purchase price for smaller buses by other systems
average purchase price for larger buses purchased by TCPS

findings.recommendation: Take action to increase cost-effectiveness of bus operations. Establish policies delineating ridership targets and travel times. Fully use automated routing software.

findings.title: TCPS Did Not Follow Proper Procurement Procedures for Bus Maintenance and Contractor Services
findings.description: Bids were not solicited for bus maintenance or contractor services. TCPS did not enter into contracts for these services.

dollar_amounts.context: expenditures for bus maintenance in fiscal year 2011
paid to two vendors for bus maintenance
payments to bus contractors for extracurricular services in fiscal year 2011

findings.recommendation: Adhere to competitive procurement policies. Ensure formal contracts are executed for significant purchases. Verify propriety of bus contractor charges.

findings.title: Internal Controls Over the Purchasing of Food Supplies Should be Strengthened
findings.description: Formal contract not executed with one vendor. No evidence that invoiced prices were agreed to contracted prices prior to payment.

dollar_amounts.context: purchases made without formal contract during fiscal year 2011

findings.recommendation: Ensure formal contracts are executed for significant purchases. Ensure invoiced prices are compared to contract prices prior to payment.

findings.title: TCPS Had Not Properly Collateralized Certain Cash Deposits
findings.description: $3,942,662 of bank balance was exposed to custodial credit risk because collateral was not held in the Board's name.

dollar_amounts.context: bank balance exposed to custodial credit risk

findings.recommendation: Ensure all deposits are properly secured with collateral held in the Board's name.

findings.title: TCPS Had Not Established a Debt Management Policy
findings.description: TCPS had not adopted formal policies governing use of debt. Notes and capital lease payables totaled $499,195.

dollar_amounts.context: notes and capital lease payables at June 30, 2011
outstanding debt to State Retirement and Pension System
total cost including interest for unfunded pension liability from 2012 to 2036

findings.recommendation: Adopt a formal policy governing management of long-term debt in accordance with best practices recommended by GFOA.

findings.title: TCPS Had Not Implemented Procedures to Ensure the Propriety of Health Care Costs
findings.description: TCPS did not verify eligibility of dependents or ensure claims paid were reviewed for propriety. TCPS paid health care provider $5.7 million.

dollar_amounts.context: paid to health care provider in fiscal year 2011
refund received from Alliance applicable to fiscal year 2011

findings.recommendation: Institute processes to verify eligibility of dependents and verify propriety of claims paid by third-party administrator.

extraction.agency_response_summary: The Board of Education generally agreed with the recommendations, providing action plans and completion dates ranging from January to December 2013. Two specific recommendation parts (Finding 2a and Finding 8a) were marked as 'No' by the agency.
extraction.extraction_notes: Report date derived from July 2013 header. Audit period derived from Scope section. Prior findings repeated count based on Status of Preceding Findings text.
